label_note: These expected scores are the project author's estimates, NOT grades assigned by a TA. They are good enough to catch a regression (a grader that starts handing a blank answer 40/50 will fail loudly) and to run the bias probes, but they are NOT evidence of accuracy. Replace them with real TA-assigned scores from a completed assignment before quoting any accuracy number to faculty or to UITS, and set label_source to "human" when you do.

probes.name: fluency
probes.why: Identical technical content, rewritten with non-native grammar. A score drop here means the grader is marking students down for how they write English rather than for what they know.

probes.name: length
probes.why: The same empty buzzword answers, padded with confident filler. A score rise here means the grader is rewarding volume and tone instead of correctness.
